newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria unit wins Spain post office tender.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria unit wins Spain post office tender.

text.p: Spanish savings bank Caja Postal, a unit of banking group Argentaria, won on Friday the tender for the distribution of financial products through the national post office network (NEXUS), a statement said.
Previously Caja Postal had been running Nexus, but the government decided to tender the concession for the next 10 years, with other banks making bids.

Argentaria will be able to offer its financial products through the post office network with a total of 1,691 technical offices and approximately 11,000 inquiry points throughout Spain, the banking group said.
No-one at Argentaria was immediately available to comment.
